title: Default check:fast from the adopted checks
goal: A projects `check:fast` is assembled from the checks it adopted, and project lines extend it
acceptance: `package-scripts.json` has `check:fast` composed of format, lint, typecheck and the backlog, rules, tooling and maintenance checks; a project line may add steps
APPLY.md says how a project with its own `check:fast` reconciles it (keep as a project override, or adopt)
A fixture shows an adopter with an own `check:fast` is not overwritten silently
Failing test committed first: the own-`check:fast` fixture expects a reported override against the current reconcile; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1.5 h plus the override fixture; five repositories already differ, so the reconcile rule is the risk. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
